Prediction error can be resolved two ways: revise the model, or act on the
world until the sensory evidence matches it. One account treats delusion as a
pathology of the first route. That account is still debated and not settled.
Akathisia may be a pathology of the second route. It would then be an inner
restlessness that carries the felt quality of an error no action can close.

Aripiprazole is the pharmacological handle. A D2 partial agonist does not act
on dopaminergic signalling the way an antagonist does, which is what makes the
question askable at all. The specific prediction that follows is held back
until the protocol is preregistered.
